risks.risk: YAML parser is intentionally limited to repository template style.
risks.notes: Recorded in the P01 phase summary and acceptable for the current config templates and generated normalized artifacts.

rationale: All P01 manifest gates ran and passed with command text matching the manifest; gate stdout/stderr files exist and match recorded SHA256 values; required artifacts and normalized config artifacts validate against their schemas; P01 is fake-only and requires no real Valkey evidence; safety checks and independent validation probes confirm no host network mutation path, no global firewall mutation path, no sudo default path, default max nodes fixed at 100, and 1000-node configs constrained to explicit opt-in dry-run.
